_target_capabilities_note: Per-target transport availability. QUIC (--listen) is available on every target. The gRPC transport (--listen-grpc) requires OpenSSL 3.x to be linked at build time AND present at runtime (libssl.so.3); where it is absent the binary is QUIC-only and `serve --listen-grpc` fails closed with error.TlsRequired. Keep this in sync with `openssl_unsupported_target` in build.zig and the before-hooks in .goreleaser.yaml.

riscv64-linux-gnu.reason: QUIC only; gRPC transport unavailable (Zig toolchain limitation). Zig 0.16 cannot @cImport libc headers for riscv64-linux ('unsupported FLEN'), so the OpenSSL binding in src/transport/grpc_tls.zig cannot be compiled for this target at all. Not a packaging gap — it needs an upstream Zig fix.

x86_64-macos.reason: QUIC only; gRPC transport unavailable in the published tarball. These binaries are cross-built on Linux and OpenSSL provisioning for a cross-compiled macOS target (Homebrew bottles) is untested, so it is left off rather than guessed at. Tracked as follow-up; a native macOS build with OpenSSL present does link it.
